primary.primary_success: available AND INCLUDED; numerical failures/unavailable/unattempted are misses, never denominator deletions
primary.completion: Every planned ordinate must be processed; budget/source/storage/unauditable/unattempted cases force NOT_COMPLETED and no gate passage.
primary.availability: All decisive and all processed counts separately reported. Numerical unknowns count as misses; no outer-set retention is substituted into the primary count.

simultaneous_CP.decision: Exact integer CP-only1921..1986; combined with unchanged old gross gate1921..1979. Floating quantiles/p-values displayed; exact combined count rule determines gate.

old_gross_gate.purpose: Retained alongside new primary-four precision gate; old28 procedure results remain historical.

truth_separation: Only generator receives full truths. Fitter sees synthetic rows, original time/error context and tested null ordinate; never truth nuisance/initialization.

entropy.bootstrap: prefix+[3,1,cadence,replicate,parameter_index], then API parameter/ordinate hash and fixed slot
entropy.development_streams: Old pilots stages0/1 and SAME532 replays stay immutable; no confirmation draw has occurred at preparation.
entropy.retuning: No method/threshold/seed/selection change after confirmation opens; all failures retained. New development after failure requires a distinct future confirmatory stream.

law_and_scope.observations: Unchanged independent Gaussian native apparent magnitudes with unchanged original supplied errors; no error rescaling.
law_and_scope.optics: Unchanged rectilinear image-summed PSPL; exactly one optical exterior in BHSM surface interpretation.
law_and_scope.statistic: Fixed finite-search LR-like algorithm applied identically observed and bootstrap. No global optimum certificate.
law_and_scope.null_generation: Constrained-null fitted nuisance, not unrestricted MLE; estimated-nuisance bootstrap remains approximate.
law_and_scope.simple_null: Exact rank exchangeability applies only to a fully specified same-law null/fixed measurable algorithm, not automatically to plug-in nuisance.
law_and_scope.physical_bounds: All original t0/tE/u0/baseline/source-fraction bounds and active physical blend faces retained.
law_and_scope.lower_unresolved: A lower finite unresolved feasible trial vetoes a selected higher resolved state; unknown ordering stays unknown.
law_and_scope.rank: Fixed B199 roster; p bounds[(1+c)/200,(1+c+unknown)/200]; reject p_upper<=.05, include p_lower>.05; lazy inclusion c>=10.
law_and_scope.mass_distance_theta_motion: All unavailable. Timescale is not BH mass/distance/absolute motion.

resources.planning: Saved raw replay rates .04377s/P0 and .17857s/P1 profile,~40 MC slots yields~2.6h at4 balanced workers plus I/O; full199 theoretical~13h plus I/O.18h supervised cap is deliberately ample, not a guaranteed duration.
resources.qualification: Deadline/storage checks are cooperative between stages; supervisor terminates children at whole limit. OS I/O and final read-only integrity/reporting can exceed the polling point; actual elapsed and any overshoot retained. Logical DB caps exclude sidecars; whole-tree cap includes all DB/journals/logs/receipts.
resources.vanished_sidecars: Cooperative size scan ignores only FileNotFoundError for a sidecar removed during the snapshot; other IO errors remain failures.

scheduling: Cases ordered replicate then cadence0/1; worker=(replicate+2*cadence)%4 gives each worker512 datasets of each cadence, independent of outcomes.

storage.per_worker: One exclusively owned SQLite DELETE/FULL database; exactly fixed test roster; no overwrite/replacement.
storage.before_outer_draw: Both parameter requests and all199 seeds commit before outer RNG. Any request failure stops every later draw/fit.
storage.outer: Store generated magnitudes, state/seed/hash and row identity once per dataset, referring to frozen original sampling parent; no repeated native observations.
storage.observed: OBSERVED_PROFILE commits before any bootstrap generation; callback failure permanently latches the procedure.
storage.bootstrap: Compact magnitudes/hash/seed/row identity commit before fit; full fitted result commits before counting comparison. Every failed/unattempted slot remains unknown.
storage.final: Full ordinal result then identity summary; all8192 initial and final identities retained before aggregate reporting.
storage.failure: Writer and worker permanent latch; supervisor stops other workers after a failed worker. No automatic replay/recovery/model calls. Raw DB+sidecars preserved; unauditable shard counts as misses.
storage.sealing: Integrity/completeness only, never statistical acceptance; read-only hashes/CRC/canonical payloads checked before inclusion.
storage.final_worker_acceptance: PASS requires all4actualprocess exitcodes0; exact successful completion receipts with correcttypedworker/planned/completed counts, no stop/sourcechange, databasepin and freshverification equal; each database must be verified sealed and complete. Missing/nonzero/unsealed/ackfailure retains allstoredfinaldecisions but everyaffected primary row is an auditmiss and fullstudy cannotPASS. Last/all-process failures and limits are checked after monitoring exits too.
storage.stop_persistence: Terminate every live child before best-effort STOP_REQUEST persistence; retain persistence errors and all remaining unknowns, then boundedwait/kill/finalidentityaccounting. A stop-file failure cannot permit more model work or PASS.

preselected_followup_audits.execution: Separate exact source/receipt admission after primary terminal; IDs fixed NOW, not selected by result.
preselected_followup_audits.grid: For each parameter,17 logarithmic nodes across unchanged full numerical domain, plus the tested original truth ordinate if absent. Same B199/null method; all failed/unknown/gap/cap states preserved.
preselected_followup_audits.endpoint_claim: Sampled-grid topology/decision audit only; no continuous finite endpoints, no exclusion between grid points, no cap-derived confidence limit. Any stronger endpoint claim stays unavailable.
preselected_followup_audits.stress_entropy: prefix+[4,0,cadence,fraction_index,replicate]; disjoint from primary3, frozen future stress source before draws.
preselected_followup_audits.stress_scope: 8 datasets/16 tests are exploratory boundary/weak-blend engineering diagnostics, not powered95% calibration or primary-family gate; no advertised stress-domain calibration.
preselected_followup_audits.no_hidden_selection: No case replacement, strongest-target ranking or failure exclusion.

history.new_method: Replacement inference procedure; no rewriting old results or pretending old tests passed.

claim_if_pass: Conditional tested-design coverage for the new MC ordinate procedure only. No known-BH recovery, gravitational-origin validation, full continuous confidence interval or publication clearance follows automatically.
